request.voice_description: Native South African English, a restrained educated South African dialect. Female, 40 to 50. Excellent clean recording quality. Persona: composed infantry leader. Emotion: watchful, controlled, quietly intense. A naturally low feminine contralto, dry and close, with precise consonants and compact deliberate phrasing. Danger makes her words slower and more exact; she can project a sharp warning without becoming shrill. Small audible breaths reveal the effort behind her composure. Restrained warmth when addressing her soldiers. Natural spoken character dialogue, varied intonation, economical pauses.
request.text:
[calm, low voice] Command, Warden. We are in position. Waiting on your word.

[focused, deliberate voice] Contact. Take a breath. Find your target.

[tense, controlled voice] Hostile mech, confirmed. Stay out of its line of fire.

[firm, projecting voice] Check fire. You are hitting our people.

[quietly urgent voice] We cannot hold this. Pull back together. Keep breathing.
